notes: Not every branch recruits teens, so call first. Volunteer jobs can involve lifting boxes of books and standing for a while.
name: Teen Volunteers (Volunteens)
what_you_do: Help at a local library branch. Some branches recruit teen Volunteens each spring to help with the Summer @ Your Library program.
who_can_apply: Anyone 14 or older. Libraries prefer a commitment of at least six months for regular volunteers.
duration: Regular volunteers: at least 6 months preferred. Volunteens: summer program.
deadline_text: Varies by branch. Teen Volunteens are recruited in the spring.
how_to_apply: Contact the branch you want. Volunteers are recruited, interviewed and trained at the local branch.
